items.description: opening the SKU detail view for a filed SKU lists a row for each location it is filed at, each showing that location's own quantity
the SKU-detail read boundary (app/routes) does not import the DB session or ORM models; read persistence is only in StockRepository (layering contract for the detail read path)
the SKU detail view for a selected SKU shows only that SKU's rows; a different SKU filed at the same or other locations never appears in the list
each row of the SKU detail view shows the tracking code (inventory_code) that was filed for that sku/location pair
a row for a sku/location filed without a par level shows an explicit "not tracked" indicator, while a row filed with a par level shows that numeric value (par_level is a nullable domain field)

the additive Alembic migration adding the nullable par_level column to stock_records applies and single-step-reverses cleanly (downgrade -1, upgrade head, @pytest.mark.migration on an isolated branch), and pre-existing rows filed before the migration survive with par_level null after upgrade (verifies PI4 for this additive change)
